name: map-spawn-rate
author: BlaXun
description: Change how many monsters spawn on any map you choose. Search maps by name or by the monsters on them in the Settings… window, give each one a rate (200% doubles it, 50% halves it), and apply. Bosses and other single-monster spawns are left alone.

settings.label: Map rates, part 1
settings.description: Written by the Settings… window: map=percent pairs separated by ';', e.g. prt_fild08=200;pay_fild04=150. The list is split across these parts because one setting holds 200 characters.
